name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi missiles at Riyadh 15 Nov; Gaza strikes
summary: Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi missiles at Riyadh on 15 Nov; Israel killed a Hamas commander in Gaza on 14 Nov
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh early on 15 Nov and drones over several regions; Saudi authorities say at least 26 people have been killed in suspected Houthi attacks since 23 Sept (Al Jazeera). An Israeli strike in al-Mawasi killed Hamas's Rafah brigade commander on 14 Nov; Gaza's health ministry reported 16 killed in the prior 48 hours (Al Jazeera; AP via KSAT). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front keep the Alert.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia before travel; advice can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes (Yemen–Saudi) and Gaza strikes = Alert

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
